title: The Unfinished Repair
fact_notes: オリジナル教材。一般的な考え方と架空の例を用いた文章であり、実在の調査、実証結果、個別機器の運用・修理手順ではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: A student organization at an imaginary school collects unwanted bicycles and attempts to prepare them for use by people who need inexpensive transportation.
sentences.ja: 架空の学校の生徒団体は不要自転車を集め安価な交通手段が必要な人が使えるよう準備しようとする。

sentences.en: The organizers hope that the project will reduce waste while providing opportunities for students to learn about the practical responsibilities involved in maintaining equipment.
sentences.ja: 主催者は廃棄を減らしながら機器維持に伴う実務責任を学ぶ機会を生徒に提供することを願う。

sentences.en: At the end of the term, the group has several bicycles that appear to be in reasonable condition, but some have not yet received a complete examination by someone with the appropriate expertise.
sentences.ja: 学期末に妥当な状態に見える自転車が数台あるが、一部は適切な専門知識を持つ人の完全な検査をまだ受けていない。

sentences.en: One organizer proposes including all of them in a public distribution event because the group initially promised to provide as many bicycles as possible before the school year ends.
sentences.ja: 当初年度終了前にできるだけ多くを提供すると約束したので、公開配布行事に全台を含めることを一主催者が提案する。

sentences.en: Another organizer questions whether the desire to fulfill that promise could lead the group to transfer responsibilities to recipients who may reasonably expect the equipment to be ready for its intended use.
sentences.ja: 約束を果たしたい願いによって団体が、本来用途に使える状態だと合理的に期待する受け手に責任を移すことにならないか別の主催者が疑問を持つ。

sentences.en: A bicycle that appears usable to an inexperienced observer may have a problem that is difficult to identify without suitable knowledge and examination.
sentences.ja: 未経験観察者に使えるように見える自転車にも適切な知識と検査なしには特定しにくい問題があるかもしれない。

sentences.en: The students recognize that completing a visible task, such as cleaning an object, is not equivalent to establishing that it is safe to use.
sentences.ja: 物を清掃するといった目に見える作業完了は安全に使用できることの確定と同等ではないと生徒は認識する。

sentences.en: The committee consequently distinguishes the number of items prepared for distribution from the number that have actually satisfied any necessary conditions for being provided to recipients.
sentences.ja: そこで委員会は配布用に準備された品数と実際に受け手への提供に必要な条件を満たした品数を区別する。

sentences.en: The organizers discuss whether it would be possible to explain the unfinished condition of particular bicycles rather than presenting them as completed donations.
sentences.ja: 一部自転車を完成寄付物として提示せず未完状態を説明できるか議論する。

sentences.en: They acknowledge, however, that a written warning by itself would not necessarily make an unsuitable item appropriate for distribution, especially if a recipient lacked the resources or knowledge needed to address its condition.
sentences.ja: しかし書面警告だけでは不適切品が必ずしも配布に適切にならないと認める。特に受け手が状態対処に必要な資源や知識を持たない場合だ。

sentences.en: The group therefore considers arranging further assessment by qualified people and postponing the distribution of items that have not been appropriately evaluated.
sentences.ja: そこで有資格者による追加評価を手配し、適切に評価されていない品の配布を延期することを検討する。

sentences.en: The fictional example is not a guide to bicycle repair or a statement about the specific safety requirements applicable to an actual donation program.
sentences.ja: 架空例は自転車修理の手引きでも実際の寄付活動に適用される特定安全要件についての記述でもない。

sentences.en: The students prepare a revised account of the project's achievements, distinguishing bicycles whose preparation has been completed from those requiring additional work and resources.
sentences.ja: 生徒は活動成果の修正版説明を作り準備完了自転車と追加作業・資源を要するものを区別する。

sentences.en: They explain why some of the originally anticipated donations have been postponed instead of reporting every collected item as a successful contribution to the community.
sentences.ja: 収集全品を成功した地域貢献と報告せず当初予定寄付の一部を延期した理由を説明する。

sentences.en: Although the revised figures may appear less impressive, they provide a more accurate explanation of the actual opportunities that the organization has made available to its intended recipients.
sentences.ja: 修正数値は印象的でなく見えても対象受け手に実際に提供した機会のより正確な説明を与える。

sentences.en: The students recognize that acknowledging unfinished work can itself demonstrate a commitment to the purpose for which the activity was established.
sentences.ja: 未完作業を認めること自体が活動設立目的への関与を示し得ると認識する。

sentences.en: A generous intention does not automatically guarantee that every action intended to express it will benefit the people for whom the action is undertaken.
sentences.ja: 寛大な意図はそれを表す目的の全行動が対象者の利益になることを自動保証しない。

sentences.en: Evaluating a contribution requires attention to the responsibilities that accompany the resources being provided and to the circumstances of the people who receive them.
sentences.ja: 貢献評価には提供資源に伴う責任と受け手の事情への注意が必要だ。

sentences.en: Sometimes a commitment is better honored by changing the timing of a promised activity than by treating the original deadline as more important than its intended purpose.
sentences.ja: 時に当初締切を目的より重要と扱うより約束活動の時期を変更する方が約束をよく守ることになる。

sentences.en: The unfinished repair illustrates why responsible assistance involves recognizing what has not yet been achieved as well as celebrating what has been completed.
sentences.ja: 未完修理は責任ある支援が完了したことを祝うだけでなく未達成を認識することも伴う理由を示す。

questions.prompt: What is the group's original purpose?
options: Sell brand-new bicycles at high prices.
Prepare unwanted bicycles for people needing inexpensive transportation.
Collect photographs of school equipment.
Train every recipient as a professional mechanic.

questions.prompt: Why does one organizer want every bicycle included?
options: Every bicycle has already been examined completely.
The recipients have agreed to repair all the bicycles.
The group intends to stop providing transportation.
The group promised to provide as many as possible by year's end.
questions.explanation_ja: 当初の約束を達成したい。

questions.prompt: What problem may arise from distributing an incompletely examined bicycle?
options: The bicycle necessarily has no useful parts.
Cleaning always guarantees safe use.
The recipient may bear a responsibility they did not expect or cannot handle.
No recipient will expect the bicycle to be usable.
questions.explanation_ja: 受け手に整備責任を移す可能性。

questions.prompt: Which distinction does the committee make?
options: Items prepared for distribution versus items meeting required conditions.
Bicycles collected this year versus all bicycles in the town.
Students who enjoy riding versus students who do not.
Visible tasks versus all tasks requiring no effort.
questions.explanation_ja: 準備した数と必要条件を満たした数。

questions.prompt: Why is a warning not necessarily sufficient?
options: Warnings automatically make equipment unsafe.
The warning guarantees a full examination.
Every recipient is necessarily qualified.
The recipient may lack the resources or knowledge to address a problem.

questions.prompt: What does the group consider doing?
options: Distribute every bicycle immediately with no conditions.
Obtain further qualified assessment and postpone unevaluated donations.
Remove all records of the items.
Require every recipient to become a mechanic.

questions.prompt: What does the revised account distinguish?
options: Completed preparations and items needing further work.
Only the appearance of bicycles.
The names of all donors and their salaries.
The original promise and no other information.

questions.prompt: Why might less impressive figures be more useful?
options: Lower figures always prove greater generosity.
The school has eliminated every safety requirement.
They more accurately represent what the recipients can actually receive.
Every collected item was already available for use.
questions.explanation_ja: 実際に提供した機会を正確に表す。

questions.prompt: What does honored mean in the context of a commitment?
options: Ignored or forgotten.
Fulfilled or respected.
Celebrated publicly with music.
Increased in monetary value.

questions.prompt: Which statement best expresses the main argument?
options: Responsible assistance prioritizes the actual benefit and safety of recipients over the appearance of fulfilling a promise.
Generosity guarantees that all donations are useful.
An original deadline must always be obeyed regardless of consequences.
The number of items collected is the only measure of success.
questions.explanation_ja: 支援の目的と受け手への責任。

grammar.focus: have not yet received a complete examination
grammar.explanation_ja: 現在完了の否定、yetはまだ。

better honored by changing the timing

paraphrases.rewrite: Some seemingly usable bicycles still need proper examination.

paraphrases.source: The students recognize that completing a visible task, such as cleaning an object, is not equivalent to establishing that it is safe to use.
paraphrases.rewrite: Completing a visible task does not establish that an item is safe.

paraphrases.source: They acknowledge, however, that a written warning by itself would not necessarily make an unsuitable item appropriate for distribution, especially if a recipient lacked the resources or knowledge needed to address its condition.
paraphrases.rewrite: A warning may be inadequate when a recipient cannot address the item's condition.

paraphrases.source: Sometimes a commitment is better honored by changing the timing of a promised activity than by treating the original deadline as more important than its intended purpose.
paraphrases.rewrite: Postponing a promised activity may better respect its purpose than meeting the original deadline.
